sections.heading: 1. Wall slide
lines: ① Back to the wall, arms in a W shape.
② Feel your shoulder blades, slide arms up slowly.
③ 10 reps × 2 sets, once or twice a day.
④ Add dead bugs for a steady trunk.

lines: You feel a catch or sharp pain in the shoulder

caption:
Momo swims 2 km of freestyle every morning, and the shoulders feel tight after long sets. 🏊

Freestyle leans heavily on the chest and the front of the shoulder. Clinical Pilates can balance that with shoulder blade control, upper back strength and rotation work, plus a steady trunk that helps you hold a long line in the water.

Hybi's tip: wall slides, 10 reps × 2 sets, once or twice a day. One or two Pilates sessions a week often fits around pool training.

Shoulder pain at night, weakness lifting your arm or pain lasting more than two weeks is worth an assessment first. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
